summary: @cacheable/net preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json scripts.preinstall runs `node setup.mjs`, a heavily obfuscated ESM file (RC4-decoded string array, shuffled tokens, hex-obfuscated identifiers) that reconstructs a GitHub releases URL for the Bun runtime from concatenated string fragments, downloads the Bun binary, chmods it executable, and then invokes it via execFileSync against the sibling file Math_Symbol.js. Math_Symbol.js is a 727KB opaque bundle carrying a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header and its own shuffled string-array + RC4-style decoder (`WV8StW` array-shift, `hc1jfK9` decoder), whose behavior is not statically determinable and is not disclosed by the README. The package advertises HTTP caching, which does not require an alternate language runtime at install time. The combination of obfuscated preinstall, download of an alternate runtime, and use of that runtime to execute an opaque bundled payload matches the alternate-runtime-dropper shape: attacker-controlled code executes on the installer's machine during `npm install`, bypassing Node-based scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
